title: fix(ui-e2e): studio-customize-journey reads open their own connection instead of a stale keep-alive socket
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiNjyvCdXYygFqntMNR7S2dW)_

Fixes #30524
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`studio-customize-journey` 这条在线 e2e 的接口读取，每次都新开一条连接（`Connection: close`），不再复用空闲了几秒的旧连接；断言一条没动。
- **为什么改**：这条用例在合并队列里三次随机报 `read ECONNRESET`，把无关的绿 PR 踢出队列、拖累后面整队重跑。实测原因是测试客户端复用了一条快要被服务器按空闲超时（6 秒）关掉的连接，不是服务器出错。
- **风险与回滚**：只改一个测试文件，不发布任何包；每次读多一次本机建连，耗时可忽略。回滚即还原这一个文件。
- **先看**：`ui/e2e/live/studio-customize-journey.spec.ts` 顶部新增的 `request` fixture 及其注释（唯一改动处）。
- **两分钟验证**：打开本 PR 的 `Live E2E UI` 检查，应为绿色，日志里 `studio-customize-journey.spec.ts` 一行为 ✓。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`ui/e2e/live/studio-customize-journey.spec.ts` overrides the `request` fixture for this spec only: the context is
`playwright.request.newContext({ extraHTTPHeaders: { Connection: 'close' } })`, so every API read the spec makes opens its
own connection and none rides a pooled keep-alive socket. The config's `storageState` and other context options still
reach it (the runner fills every option the call does not name). The browser's traffic is unchanged. Every assertion,
step and cleanup is unchanged.

## Cause (measured)

- Playwright 1.63's `APIRequestContext` pools sockets with `http.Agent({ keepAlive: true })` and no agent `timeout`.
  With no agent timeout, Node's agent does not apply the server's `Keep-Alive: timeout=5` hint, so a pooled socket is
  kept until the server closes it.
- The backend (`@hono/node-server` on Node 22, default options) answers `keep-alive: timeout=5` and closes an idle
  socket at `keepAliveTimeout` 5000 + `keepAliveTimeoutBuffer` 1000 = 6000 ms (both read from
  `http.createServer()` on Node 22.23.4).
- In this spec the read right after the customize step (`threeReads`, the `servedColumns` GET) reuses the socket of
  the read before the browser steps. A client-side socket trace measured its idle at **4710–5153 ms** on 5 solo runs
  and **4785–5010 ms** on 3 runs of the full CI allowlist. That is the largest idle of any API read in the allowlist,
  and it is about one second short of the server's close. A slower runner pushes it onto 6 s.
- Against the real booted backend, the spec's own GET on a socket idled 5994–6000 ms: **7 of 40 failed** with
  `apiRequestContext.get: read ECONNRESET` (3) or `socket hang up` (4). With `Connection: close`: **0 of 40**.
- The three CI hits (PR #30341 run 41981408406 job 127092282802, merge-group jobs 127279783258 and 127290410036) fail
  at the same call, `servedColumns` from `threeReads` at spec line 159, right after `publishPair`. The test dies at
  6.5–6.6 s, 16 others pass, and the backend pid recorded at boot is the pid stopped at the end. The next spec passes
  within 4 s, while a backend boot takes 14 s. So nothing restarted the server: one pooled socket was reset.

## Tests

The fixed spec ran 12/12 green against a stack booted the way the `Live E2E UI` job boots it (start-backend.sh,
`vite preview` proxying `/api`, `--retries 0`). The derived gate commands ran beside it, so the box was loaded. A socket
trace of the fixed spec shows **19 fresh connections and 0 reused**. The unfixed spec showed 16 reused per run, the
largest idle 5153 ms.

  ✓   7 … (16.9s)  ✓   8 … (15.2s)  ✓   9 … (15.6s)  ✓  10 … (14.5s)  ✓  11 … (14.4s)  ✓  12 … (14.0s)

```
</details>

  idle 5996ms -> {"200":6,"apiRequestContext.get: read ECONNRESET":2,"apiRequestContext.get: socket hang up":2}

5010 GET /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.in_progress   (journey, after customize)
4444 GET /api/v1/meta/object/showcase_task             (journey, after the extension step)
4123 GET /api/v1/meta/page/e2e_studio_editor_…          (studio-editor)
3537 GET /api/v1/meta/object/e2e_asset…                 (studio-object-designer)
4785 / 4420 / 4090 / 3538 · 4791 / 4219 / 4007 / 3498   (rounds 2 and 3, same order)
51 passed (2.9m)
```
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The unfixed spec did not go red locally: 20/20 alone and 51/51 in the allowlist x3. On this box the idle stays near
  5 s, under the server's 6 s close. The failure was reproduced at the socket level against the real backend (above).
- The CI artifacts' `backend.log` could not be read from the measuring container: the artifact blob host is refused by
  its egress proxy. The no-restart reading rests on the job logs: the same pid at boot and at stop, and the next spec
  passing.
- Other live specs make reads after Studio steps on a reused socket, with a measured idle of 3.5–4.1 s
  (`studio-editor`, `studio-object-designer`). They are under the 6 s close today, so this PR leaves them unchanged.
  carrier: none.

## Verification

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 19 commands for this diff. All 19 ran locally, each exit code
  captured before any pipe, and `--ran` reconciles them. The per-gate readings are on the issue's `os-dev-report`
  comment.
- No changeset: the diff touches only `ui/e2e/live/**`, which no package's `files[]` ships (`ui/package.json` is the
  private `object-ui-monorepo`), so the PR carries `skip-changeset`.
